english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who lives in a particular place or area.
Use this concise noun for inhabitants of an area, community, or habitat, including non-human inhabitants in suitable contexts.

examples.english: A resident in this area said it was too noisy downstairs.
examples.traditional: 呢區有個居民話樓下太嘈。
examples.jyutping: ni1 keoi1 jau5 go3 geoi1 man4 waa6 lau4 haa6 taai3 cou4

examples.english: Each inhabitant of this village is very helpful.
examples.traditional: 呢條村嘅居民個個都好熱心。
examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 cyun1 ge3 geoi1 man4 go3 go3 dou1 hou2 jit6 sam1
